[NSTG.5.6.1] Samples are drop-oldest per [LSER.8.3] /
[LSTO.3.5] / [LSTO.6.3]. The engine never propagates
sample-emission failures to rules; the only feedback loop
is via the `ds.samples.dropped_total` metric. Integrators
needing visibility into drop rates wire their metrics
callback (per the runtime's metric-emission surface) to
scrape or forward that counter.
